verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean states the same two decompositions with the bump sum packaged inside `repair`: unfolding `repairU`/`repairE` through `LocalizedMomentRepair.repair`, the corrections are literally ∑_{j : Fin 2} α_j(η)·b_j^U(R) and ∑_{j : Fin 3} β_j(η)·b_j^E(R), the coefficients being (B_U)⁻¹ and (B_E)⁻¹ applied to the η-dependent debt vector and smooth in η (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ du (univ ×ˢ S)). Two encoding steps are needed. (i) In GlobalSlowProfiles the corrections are symmetrized in R to stay even: un = u n + evenCorrection du with (evenCorrection du)(R,η) = du(R,η) + du(-R,η), and for R ≥ 0 this equals du(R,η) because supp du ⊂ (a,b) with a > 0 (evenCorrection_nonneg); so on the paper's range R ≥ 0 the two agree. (ii) The paper takes E_n as the unknown and defines φ_n = (C/R)E_n; the Lean takes φ_n as the unknown, sets E := angularField C φ = (R/C)φ, and adds the correction to φ through `phiCorrection`, which is exactly the quotient C·(correction)/R and is proved to reproduce the prescribed E-correction for R ≥ 0 (phiCorrection_angular_nonneg). The paper's remark that at R = 0 the quotient is the smooth extension and φ_n = φ̃_n there is the content of phiCorrection's smoothness proof at w.1 = 0 and of exists_repaired_order's clause `|R| ≤ a → phin = phi n`.
